Subject: Coord: DST overlap — request for demo padding & backup slots

Hi Sylvia,

Thanks again for scheduling the demo — looking forward to walking through the Dedicated deployment and latency profile. I booked a 45-minute slot for Wed Nov 5 at 10:00 AM ET (10:00 AM US/Eastern) which should map to 15:00 CET for your team.

Quick note: because of the DST changeover this week (US falls back on Nov 2, Europe already fell back Oct 26), there is a one-week period where the usual ET-to-CET conversion is shifted by an hour. To reduce confusion and prevent clock-related no-shows, could we add 15–30 minutes of padding after the demo for any follow-ups, and confirm whether your calendar shows the event at 15:00 CET?

If that time doesn't work for others on your side, alternative slots we can offer:
- Wed Nov 5, 11:30 AM ET / 16:30 CET
- Thu Nov 6, 07:00 PM ET / Fri 00:00 CET (if you need an APAC-friendly handoff)

I've attached the short MATP (model acceptance test plan) we'll demo and a calendar screenshot showing local times. If you'd like, we can provision a backup host from our side in a different region (we can have Logan cover the EU-facing host or Dylan cover an APAC-friendly slot).

Next steps: please confirm which time looks correct on your end and whether you want the extra 30-minute buffer. Once you confirm I'll update the calendar and push the HubSpot activity.

Attachments: BrightBank-demo-MATP.pdf

Best,
Hannah Schmitt

- If you can propose one earlier slot (to be friendlier to our EMEA ops) and one later slot (to accommodate APAC), that would be ideal.

Can Logan join as the EU-facing host? If so please add him to the invite. Otherwise we'll accept the 10:00 AM ET / 15:00 CET slot with the 30-minute buffer.
